observations.command:
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 || exit 31
test "$(pidof avocd)" = 706 || exit 32
date -u
cat /proc/uptime
awk 'index($0,"libave.so") {print; tv_tail=5; next} tv_tail>0 {print;tv_tail--}' /proc/706/maps
od -An -t x4 -j 4145142252 -N 4 /proc/706/mem
